text:
Disney+ on Meta Quest | 3D Movies & Immersive Environments
Your favorite Disney+ movies just got a whole new dimension. The Disney+ app now streams select movies in 3D on Meta Quest, including Marvel’s The Avengers and more, all included in your subscription. Select titles are also available with Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos for eligible subscribers.

Immersive themed environments surround you while you watch. Catch Rogue One: A Star Wars Story from a comfy spot on Tatooine, see the Avengers battle Loki from atop Avengers Tower, or settle in for a Pixar movie night on the Monsters, Inc. Scare Floor.

Download the Disney+ app now on the Meta Horizon Store: https://www.meta.com/experiences/disney/10068174916592965/

Stream Disney+: https://www.disneyplus.com/

Coming to Meta VR Glasses Spring 2027.

Disney+ subscription required. Must be 18+ to subscribe. © 2026 Disney and its related entities. Availability of 3D playback on Disney+ varies by region and device. Some titles shown may not be available in 3D in your country.
